propositions: Data Center backend has no value-pinning characterization suite; existing test_backend_contract.py only asserts shape (presence of keys) not values, leaving DC's recently-added implementations untested for correctness.

The create-path mapper _map_local_to_dc_fields must be pinned by value for every emitted key: summary, description (through WikiTextCodec.fit_outbound), issuetype, priority, status, assignee, including all default-fallback branches and empty-string cases.
DC sanitizer boundaries for summary, description, and comment must be pinned at-limit and one-over, including the truncation suffix marker _WIKI_TRUNCATION_SUFFIX.

The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote must be exercised through WikiTextCodec to pin that description over WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is truncated correctly, non-str description passes through untouched, and status/priority/title use DC values.

DC probe classification must be pinned by value through the real classifier (jira_family.classify_probe_response or JiraDataCenterTransport), not through FakeTransport, reaching all four branches: PRESENT_RESOLVED, PRESENT_FILTERED, ARCHIVED_OR_MOVED, UNREACHABLE.
DC must bind its own resolved_statuses config distinctly from Cloud's, proven by asserting that a custom non-default status set classifies correctly in DC but differently in Cloud.
